code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the repeated-row color key, read left to right.
    candidates = []
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            for ph in range(1, h-y+1):
                for pw in range(2, w-x+1):
                    row = grid[y][x:x+pw]
                    if (all(v != 0 for v in row) and len(set(row)) == pw and
                        all(grid[y+i][x:x+pw] == row for i in range(ph))):
                        candidates.append((pw, ph, y, x, row))
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    pw, ph, py, px, palette = max(candidates, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
    # All color-1 cells outside the key form the template, including diagonal parts.
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] == 1 and not (py <= r < py+ph and px <= c < px+pw)]
    r0 = min(r for r,c in cells); r1 = max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r,c in cells); c1 = max(c for r,c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells]
    sh = r1-r0+1
    center = palette.index(1) if 1 in palette else len(palette)//2
    top = r0 - center*sh
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i, color in enumerate(palette):
        yy0 = top + i*sh
        for dy, dx in shape:
            yy, xx = yy0+dy, c0+dx
            if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                out[yy][xx] = color
    return out
'''
